content:
**Bee's Treasure Hunt** is an unmarked quest in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

| Unmarked Quest: Bee's Treasure Hunt | | | | | |
| Find Bee's Diary page 1 | | | | | |
| Travel counter clockwise around Shenandoah, finding the Steel Jack Statues, and collecting Bee's Diaries from where the statues are pointing. | | | | | |
| Follow the clues from the Diary pages to find the treasure at the Rocky Overview. | | | | | |

| Image | Location | Note Location |

| Image | Note description |
| | **interesting trail off to the side of the Slumber Mill** |
| | **I came across a really cute tree stump with shrooms growing all over it.** |
| | **a small rocky pass with a beautiful tree splitting the road.** |
| | **I found a trail leading off to the right.** |
| | **I've hidden a small trinket cache in a stump next to the resting area, and marked it with an axe.** |
